title: 📱 "iPhone 18 Pro" May Connect to the Internet Directly via Satellite!
body: 📱 "iPhone 18 Pro" May Connect to the Internet Directly via Satellite!

New leaks suggest the upcoming "iPhone 18 Pro" may support connecting to 5G networks via satellites, thanks to Apple's new "C2" modem, the chip that manages the phone's connection to networks. The technology in question is known as "NR-NTN", and it allows the phone to connect directly to satellites in low Earth orbit to reach the internet, even outside the coverage of traditional cell towers.

Today, Apple's use of satellites is limited to emergency messages and text messages only — there is no full internet from space yet. But the new technology could open the door to direct satellite connection, or through carriers that use satellites to cover remote areas. 2026 is expected to be a turning point in the adoption of this technology, but all of the above remains a leak from an unofficial source, and Apple has not confirmed it yet.

Simply put: your phone today needs a nearby cell tower to work, but with this technology it could connect directly to a satellite above your head — will satellite internet become a basic feature in phones?
